rag.text:
Test: TC-6040 — SPM - OKR - Convert objective from Auto to Manual progress tracking
Priority: High | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
* Verify the Objective conversion flow from automatic to manual progress tracking
* verify that the conversion option is available and works correctly from the Objective menu
* verify that after conversion, the *progress field becomes editable*
* verify that the *previous progress value is preserved and pre-filled*

Steps:
1. Open OKR Module → Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6040 SPM - OKR - Convert objective from Auto to Manual progress tracking
   Expected: OKR Overview is opened
2. Click Add → Create strategic theme
   Expected: Creation modal is opened. Progress tracking *Child OKRs* is selected
3. Enter name, set period and click create
   Expected: Strategic theme is created and visible in tree view
4. Navigate to strategic theme and click Add (+) button → Add sub-objective
   Expected: Creation modal is opened. Progress tracking *Child OKRs* is selected
5. Enter name, set period and click create
   Expected: Objective is created and visible in tree view under the strategic theme
6. Navigate to Objective and click Add + button → add key-result
   Expected: Creation modal is opened. Progress tracking *Manual progres tracking* is selected
7. Enter name, set period and set *Linked items progress* tracking
   Expected: Name is filled, period and progress tracking are selected
The message " _Progress updates automatically based on the status of linked Jira work items or boxes._" is displayed
8. Being in creation KR modal click *Link work items* → find space name and link all issues from space
   Data: spaceName: TC-6040 SPM - OKR - Convert objective from Auto to Manual progress tracking
   Expected: All issues from Space are linked to key-result
9. Click Create
   Expected: Key result is created and visible in tree view under objective
10. Click Go back OKR Overview and navigate to Progress field
   Expected: Strategic theme, objective and key result are visible in Overview
The progress for OKR is displayed as follows:

Strategic theme - 33.33%
Objective - 33.33%
Key-result - 33.33%
11. Open Objective in detail page → click tree dots → click *Convert to manual-progress tracking*
   Expected: Modal is opened. the message is visible

_Converting from automatic progress tracking to a manual means that your Objective progress will no longer be updated automatically based on child OKRs progress.  Your current progress will remain the same and no previous update will be deleted._
12. Click *Convert*
   Expected: The message appears:

*_Success_*

_Objective progress tracking type was successfully updated_
13. Go back to Overview and navigate to progress field
   Expected: The progress for OKR is displayed as follows:

Strategic theme - 33.33%
Objective - 33.33%
Key-result - 33.33%
14. Open Objective in detail page and click *Update* button
   Expected: Objective update modal is opened, progress  33.33% is visible in Update current progress field
15. Change progress to 40% and click Submit
   Expected: Message is displayed:
 _Success_

_Your objective has been updated._
16. Go back to Overview and navigate to progress field
   Expected: The progress for OKR is displayed as follows:

Strategic theme - 40%
Objective - 40%
Key-result - 33.33%
